001.title: Finish the font analysis WIP and make the branch green
001.brief:
Goal: make branch feature/0.2.6 clippy-clean (`cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings`) by wiring the unused font-analysis code, then add the tests and Russian strings listed below. Commit only green states.

1. Wire `suggest_fonts` (crates/ui-egui/src/font_substitute.rs:169). Call it when Edit PDF's text editing is active and a page is shown. Candidate hook: canvas.rs ~2429, where `view.objects.prepare(doc, tool == QuickTool::EditText && can_modify, ...)` runs for `QuickTool::EditText`; or edit_text_ui.rs `page_input` (camera_ui.rs:61 is the input entry point). Pick one that runs once per page view, not every frame. `page_fonts` is cached per `(id, page)` by `edit_generation()`, so the call is cheap, but `suggest_fonts` opens a dialog, so it must not reopen after dismissal (it uses `fonts.suggested`; verify that). Do not change the Match::Other logic.
2. Tests:
   - pdfcraft-edit (crates/edit/src/text.rs:169 `font_facts`, :212 `first_unencodable`): synthetic CIDFontType2 whose FontFile2 name table says family "Rect Font", weight 700, with /BaseFont "CIDFont+F1". Assert family/weight come from the program. Assert `first_unencodable` returns the first unencodable char. Build the font with crates/engine/tests/support/font_fixture.rs (in-memory generator). Check whether that helper is reachable from the edit crate's tests; if not, build the fixture locally.
   - pdfcraft-engine (crates/engine/src/text_fonts.rs:149 `Wanted::from_facts`): assert program family/weight win over flags.
   - Styled edit: bold on a paragraph whose real family has an installed or registered bold face must pick that face, not standard Helvetica-Bold. See `styled_face` and `rank` in font_substitute.rs.
3. Add Russian lines to crates/ui-egui/src/i18n/ru.tsv for every new UI string (the `sintec_guard` test checks coverage), e.g. "No similar font is installed. Choose the font edited text in it is set in." Then run `python zz_rehash.py crates/ui-egui/src/i18n/ru.tsv` and `cargo xtask assets`.

Constraints (CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md): no unwrap/expect/panic/indexing on input-derived positions in non-test code; use checked arithmetic and `get`. Never commit fonts, Downloads PDFs or corpus files. Use `Result` and existing error enums. No unsafe.

Done when: `cargo fmt --all --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings`, and `cargo test -p pdfcraft-edit -p pdfcraft-engine -p pdfcraft-ui-egui` (plus the fourth crate you touched) all pass, `cargo xtask assets` passes, and the new tests fail if the feature is reverted. Report the call site you chose and why.
